title: Cucumber and BDD: Specs Everyone Can Read
description: What Behaviour-Driven Development is, how Cucumber turns plain-language Gherkin scenarios into automated tests, and how to keep a Cucumber suite readable, fast and trustworthy.
audience: Developers and testers new to BDD; examples use Java with Cucumber-JVM and JUnit 5.

chapters.title: How Cucumber Fits Together
chapters.summary: From the BDD conversation to Gherkin, step definitions, the runner, hooks and reports, on one map you rebuild from memory.

chapters.title: Writing Good Scenarios
chapters.summary: Ten review decisions on real-looking scenarios: declarative steps, one behaviour each, Backgrounds, Outlines, tags and shared state.

chapters.title: Why Our BDD Failed
chapters.summary: A team adopted Cucumber and got slow, brittle tests nobody reads. Find out what really went wrong.

chapters.title: Suite Maths
chapters.summary: Play with flaky odds, retries, UI versus API steps, parallel runs and exploding Scenario Outlines.

chapters.title: Cucumber Archipelago
chapters.summary: One island per big idea, hands-on activities, then a final exam.
